set.body: From the cold review of 23db27133 (F2, F8). Sections 1-2 still name the streams media-part-b-video-0 and -audio-0, but the amendment content-addresses them by streamhash; reconcile. The amendment drops it and singular they from third-person pronouns, which narrows section 2 and the section 7 universe (3 tokens on real data); this needs owner acknowledgement under SD5 rather than the label within approved scope.
set.title: S3c-2 follow-up: ADR 0027 stream names and pronoun-set acknowledgement
